verdict.rationale: The only wearable evidence says Authenticator notifications can be mirrored from the phone to a wearable device. That is an adjacent notification-mirroring behavior, not a documented capability to read one-time password codes on a smartwatch, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone

citations.quote: you can mirror Authenticator notifications from your phone to your wearable device.
